skill.name: remotion-video
skill.description: Build and render React video compositions with Remotion. Animate scenes by frame, sync motion to audio, and generate video variants from structured data.
skill.summary: Create reusable React video templates and render them with Remotion.
skill.author: iart-ai

security_audit.summary: All 49 static alerts are false positives for the reported patterns, including Markdown and JavaScript backticks and two unrelated timing references. The review identified unvalidated batch-render paths and references to helper scripts absent from the package. No evidence of prompt injection, malicious reconnaissance, or data exfiltration was found.

remediation.issue: Batch render examples derive paths from record IDs.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only a strict set of filename characters, quote shell arguments, and verify both input and output paths remain under their intended directories.

remediation.issue: The verification section calls missing helper scripts packaged tooling.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the helper calls or ship reviewed helpers with the skill. Tell readers not to substitute unrelated scripts from the working directory.

semantic_findings.title: Batch IDs Are Not Validated as Filenames
semantic_findings.description: The CLI example uses a record ID to select the props file and output path. The JavaScript example also derives the output path directly from an ID. Untrusted IDs could redirect file access outside the intended directories.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both examples insert IDs into paths without showing validation or containment checks. The impact depends on where the IDs originate and the renderer's permissions.

semantic_findings.title: Unshipped Helpers May Resolve to Project Scripts
semantic_findings.description: The verification instructions label two relative script commands as packaged helpers, but neither script ships in this revision. Running those commands from a project could execute unrelated files with matching names.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The commands are explicit, and neither helper exists in the reviewed file tree. No evidence was found that the skill supplies or downloads replacement files.

content.value_statement: Manually editing each video variant takes time and makes changes hard to repeat. Build a reusable React composition, preview exact frames, and render new versions from input data.
actual_capabilities: Animate opacity and transforms from frame numbers with interpolation and springs.
Schedule scenes with sequences and overlap shots for transitions.
Expose editable inputs in Remotion Studio with Zod and calculate duration from input data.
Trim and fade audio, then align motion to beat timestamps calculated before rendering.
Preview exact frames as PNG stills and export MP4, GIF, or WebM with the CLI.
Bundle a composition once and render one video per record with the Node renderer.
limitations: Rendering requires a configured Remotion project and installed dependencies.
The skill is documentation, not a visual video editor.
Automatic beat detection requires a separate preprocessing step.
The contact sheet and MP4 inspection helpers mentioned in the guide are not included.

use_cases.title: Animate a title sequence
use_cases.description: Create a short title animation with predictable timing and adjustable text.

use_cases.title: Produce branded promo variants
use_cases.description: Reuse one vertical promo composition with different headlines, accent colors, and audio tracks.

use_cases.title: Render videos from records in CI
use_cases.description: Generate one MP4 per record from a shared composition, with duration based on the input data.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a title
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-second Remotion title card at 30 frames per second. Fade in the headline and give it a subtle spring entrance. Preview the first, middle, and last frames.

prompt_templates.title: Create an editable promo
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Reuse a layout with different copy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a vertical Remotion promo with opening, product, and closing scenes. Make the headline and accent color editable in Studio with Zod. Verify stills using my delivery props.

prompt_templates.title: Sync motion to music
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Use an existing audio track and beat list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my local audio track and supplied beat timestamps in a Remotion composition. Align a subtle scale pulse to each beat. Derive timing from the frame number.

prompt_templates.title: Batch render MP4 variants
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Render a record set in CI.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a headless Remotion pipeline that bundles once and renders one MP4 per validated record. Derive duration from record data. Keep output names inside the render directory and preview one representative record before the batch.

output_examples.input: Create a five-second vertical launch promo with an editable headline.
output_examples.output: A reusable vertical composition and an MP4 preview. The headline fades in on the opening scene and can be changed in Studio.

output_examples.input: Render three product records with different scene counts.
output_examples.output: Three MP4 files from one composition. Each video's duration follows its scene count. A representative set of stills shows how the record data fits the layout.

best_practices: Preview the first, middle, and last frames with delivery inputs before encoding.
Clamp interpolation when values should stay within the chosen range.
Validate record IDs before using them to select input files or name output videos.
anti_patterns: Drive animation from wall clocks, timers, or unseeded random values.
Analyze audio beats during headless rendering instead of preparing timestamps first.
Render an entire batch before checking a representative record for clipped text and missing assets.

faq.question: Which formats can I render?
faq.answer: The examples cover MP4, GIF, and WebM exports, plus PNG stills for frame checks.

faq.question: Can I change text and colors without editing components?
faq.answer: Yes. Define those values as props and expose them in Remotion Studio with a Zod schema.

faq.question: Can the video duration depend on the data?
faq.answer: Yes. The composition can calculate its frame count from its inputs before rendering.

faq.question: Can I render videos without opening Studio?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the Remotion CLI or Node renderer to render without the Studio interface.

faq.question: How does audio sync work?
faq.answer: Prepare beat timestamps before rendering. The composition converts each frame to seconds and uses those times to trigger motion.

faq.question: Does the skill include verification scripts?
faq.answer: No. The documented helper scripts are not packaged. You can render individual stills with the Remotion CLI and inspect them directly.
